notes.title: New anomalies and languages
notes.content:
Thanks for the useful feedback everyone!

The purpose of this patch is to make the game a bit more challenging.

Content of the patch:
- 6 new minor anomalies
- increased number of floor levels
- minor fixes and modifications
- additional localized languages: Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Polski, Română, Español, Nederlands, Українська, Русский (sorry if the translations aren't perfect, unfortunately only google translate)
